column3: BSB renders “having been enlightened” as “you were in the light.”
BSB renders “this … this” as “Sometimes … at other times.”
BSB follows the critical text with “those in prison” and without “in heaven,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB follows the critical text with “My righteous one” (μου) and renders “My soul takes no pleasure” as “I will take no pleasure.”
BSB renders “of faith to the preserving of the soul” as “of those who have faith and preserve their souls.”
